purpose: Expose a compact, keyboard-focusable affordance for consumer-owned reordering.
useWhen: a sortable row or item needs a visible handle
the consumer owns the drag and drop state
avoidWhen: the whole row is draggable without an explicit handle
a menu or more-actions trigger is intended
accessibility: Uses the shared IconButton focus, label, and disabled semantics.
Adds a sortable role description without claiming ownership of the drag state.
responsive: Retains the shared touch target in dense rows and narrow layouts.
Can be placed in a Stack without changing row semantics.

api.name: label
api.description: Visible or accessible name for the control.

api.name: disabled
api.description: Prevents interaction while preserving the disabled state.

api.name: onPointerDown
api.description: Callback fired when pointer down changes.
